name: Jeevan Scientific Technology Limited
about: Jeevan Scientific Technology Limited engages in the clinical research and data management businesses in India. The company's services include BA/BE studies that comprise bioanalytical and clinical services, pharmacokinetic and biostatistics, and glucose clamping; clinical trial services, such as medical writing, clinical trial management and monitoring, drug safety, clinical data management, biostatistics and statistical programming, and quality assurance. It also offers pharmacovigilance services, including ICSR management, aggregate safety reports, risk management plan, signal detection, medical information call center, and other integrated services. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Jeevan Softech Limited and changed its name to Jeevan Scientific Technology Limited in March 2011. Jeevan Scientific Technology Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
